title: Abstract Geometric Figure with Spheres
coreRelationships: The geometric shapes interlock and stack to form a humanoid bust.
Spheres are strategically placed to suggest facial features and structural elements.
The textured, cracked surface of the figure contrasts with the smoother, darker background.
Light and shadow define the three-dimensionality of each geometric component.
reuseFormula: Generate an abstract, geometric bust-like figure composed of interlocking blocks and spheres, rendered with a heavily textured, cracked, and aged stone-like appearance. Use a predominantly cool, desaturated color palette with strong chiaroscuro lighting to create depth. Place the figure centrally against a dark, desaturated teal background. Integrate the letters 'SPC' as if carved or etched into one of the figure's blocks, matching the distressed, sans-serif style and texture.
